source_name: ALARB Arabic Legal Argument Reasoning Benchmark
description: Arabic benchmark of commercial court cases with facts, reasoning, verdicts, and cited clauses.
task: verdict prediction; reasoning completion; regulation identification
evidence_summary: The dataset card declares Apache-2.0, Arabic, Parquet, and train/test configurations; the paper defines the evaluation tasks and Saudi commercial-case provenance.
provenance: HF dataset card plus ACL paper; underlying court-record permissions are not independently established.
known_quality_issues: Original-record rights and privacy mitigation were not independently inspected; dataset-card declarations are not court permission.
required_rights: Original-record rights; PII mitigation; public-display and demo permissions.
manual_action: Confirm original-record rights, PII mitigation, public-display and demo permissions before any redistribution.
notes: Declared dataset licence is recorded separately from original-source and privacy rights.

original_publisher: Saudi legal documents and synthesized questions
description: Multitask benchmark for Arabic legal knowledge with document-derived and synthesized questions.
task: legal knowledge evaluation; classification; question answering
evidence_summary: The Hugging Face card identifies 27032 Parquet rows across ArLegalBench, MCQs, and QA; the paper and exact GitHub repository describe the benchmark and code separately.
provenance: Hugging Face dataset release, paper, and exact GitHub code repository are tracked as separate records of evidence.
known_quality_issues: Dataset, code, and source-document rights are unresolved; synthetic questions do not resolve rights in source documents.
required_rights: Dataset licence; code licence; source-document rights; privacy; access conditions.
manual_action: Inspect the Hugging Face dataset card and GitHub repository licence files separately without assuming either release grants rights.

description: Published corpus pairing full court decisions with human abstractive summaries and three category labels.
evidence_summary: The MDPI paper records 9,699 Saudi cases, Administrative/Commercial/Criminal categories, and full decisions with human summaries; the exact repository is recorded and has no verified dataset licence.
provenance: Paper attributes original cases to the Saudi Board of Grievances; repository is the author release path.
known_quality_issues: Repository dataset licence and original court-record rights are missing; privacy and technical quality require review.
required_rights: Dataset licence; original-source rights; privacy; training and display rights; access conditions.
manual_action: Obtain the repository licence and written permission or a documented legal basis for case-text reuse; confirm training and display rights.
notes: Paper and repository are canonical records; no dataset downloaded.
split_info: Train: 7759; test: 1940; categories: Administrative 6727; Commercial 2035; Criminal 937.

description: Arabic case dataset containing case text, summaries, keywords, and categories.
task: classification; information extraction; summarisation; question answering
evidence_summary: The Data in Brief article records 3,170 cases, 47 classes, Saudi provenance, CSV data, and summaries/keywords/categories; the Kaggle DOI is 10.34740/KAGGLE/DSV/10529826.
provenance: Paper says cases were collected from the Board of Grievances judgments page and published on Kaggle.
known_quality_issues: Kaggle dataset licence could not be verified; paper CC BY applies to the article, not automatically to the dataset or court records; OCR and cleansing quality concerns remain.
required_rights: Verify Kaggle dataset licence, source rights, privacy, and automated access before acquisition or quoting.
manual_action: Request or verify the Kaggle licence and Board of Grievances reuse terms; do not treat the article CC BY as dataset permission.
split_info: Article reports CSV; the paper describes 47 classes and summaries, keywords, and categories.

description: Arabic commercial court rulings with citation-oriented structured fields.
task: case citation; commercial case analysis; classification
evidence_summary: Mendeley Data version 3, published 2026-05-26, declares CC BY 4.0 and provides the current CSV/XLSX release metadata; the paper claims anonymisation.
provenance: Data paper states an initial 14,857 records and 12,806 final commercial cases sourced from the Saudi Ministry of Justice portal; current Mendeley release is version 3.
known_quality_issues: Anonymisation is a claim until files are inspected; original MOJ rights and public demonstration rights are not established by the Mendeley licence.
conditions: Use only after inspecting redaction and confirming original-source permissions; public display requires separate approval.
required_rights: Original MOJ rights; PII inspection; public-display and public-demo permission; model-training decision.
manual_action: Inspect the current Mendeley version 3 files and obtain confirmation that the claimed anonymisation and source rights support the intended use.
notes: Version 3; DOI 10.17632/np538c95yy.3; published 2026-05-26; current CSV/XLSX release.

source_name: Saudi Ministry of Justice designated open data
description: MOJ open-data library and datasets published through Saudi open-data channels.
task: aggregate statistics; metadata; possible future text-data candidate
evidence_summary: The MOJ library and policy identify an open-data route; the national licence permits reuse subject to attribution and notices, but item-level metadata controls.
provenance: Named government publisher; no text-bearing dataset selected or downloaded.
known_quality_issues: Most visible open-data items are aggregate statistics, not a legal-text corpus; item-level privacy and licence review remains required.
conditions: Attribution, licence notices, item-level terms, and privacy classification are required.
required_rights: Identify a named text-bearing item and verify it is licensed for automated acquisition, processing, indexing, quotation, and demo.
manual_action: Select a specific item from the library and record its dataset card and terms before treating it as a corpus.
notes: Candidate route only; not the primary corpus.
split_info: National licence is not a blanket licence for general MOJ portal content.

source_name: Saudi Ministry of Justice general portal content
description: General MOJ pages, laws, circulars, services, and public content outside a designated dataset.
evidence_summary: The open-data policy applies to designated open data; it does not establish reuse rights for all general portal content.
provenance: Government portal authority is established; no corpus item was copied.
known_quality_issues: Public visibility is not a redistribution or automated-access grant; copyright and quotation limits remain unresolved.
required_rights: Obtain page-specific reuse and automated-access permission for any copied text.
manual_action: Keep as a reference lead only; do not use general portal pages as the primary corpus.
notes: Open-data policy and portal content are separate rights layers.

source_name: Saudi Board of Grievances open data
description: Board open-data catalogue and use policy covering published aggregate judicial statistics and possible source pages.
evidence_summary: The catalogue describes cases, incoming cases, completed cases, judgments, and hearings as open-data statistics; the usage guide requires source attribution and prohibits distortion.
provenance: Official Board catalogue and usage guide; no case payload accessed.
known_quality_issues: The identified open-data content is aggregate and does not itself establish a reusable full-text judgment corpus; access and privacy for judgment pages remain separate.
conditions: Attribution and no distortion are required; item-level rights for text must be confirmed.
required_rights: Determine whether any named text-bearing catalogue item exists and obtain its access, licence, privacy, and quotation terms.
manual_action: Aggregate open data is not proposed as Kawaneen's legal-text primary corpus.
notes: The catalogue is evidence of statistical open data, not full-text redistribution permission.
split_info: Judgments page is a separate candidate source.

source_name: Saudi Bureau of Experts legislation portal
description: Official Saudi legislation portal and its terms of use.
evidence_summary: Terms describe personal use and restrictions on unreasonable load; no general redistribution or automated-access permission was found.
provenance: Official Bureau portal is authoritative for displayed legislation; terms govern portal use.
known_quality_issues: No standalone open-data licence was verified; automation and corpus mirroring are not approved.
required_rights: Written permission or a machine-readable licence for copying, automation, quotation, and demo.
manual_action: Do not automate or mirror under current terms; seek written permission if needed.
notes: Official authority does not resolve reuse rights.

description: Official Court of Cassation legal-information site with subscriber access to full decisions and principles.
evidence_summary: The May 2026 terms permit legal, academic, research, and documentary viewing/copying; prohibit commercial or unapproved publication; require subscription access; and prohibit unlawful extraction.
provenance: Court site and exact May 2026 terms page.
known_quality_issues: Terms do not grant automated corpus acquisition, public redistribution, commercial use, or demo rights.
conditions: Legal/academic/research use only; subscription and Court controls apply.
required_rights: Confirm account/access terms and obtain written permission before automated extraction or public quotation.
manual_action: May 2026 terms are the canonical access and copyright evidence.
notes: Not a public-demo or primary-corpus candidate under current terms.
split_info: Exact terms page last updated May 2026.

publisher: Egyptian Ministry of Justice and official publishers
description: Candidate official legislation portals retained for manual source-specific review.
evidence_summary: Government domain establishes provenance only; a page-specific licence, terms, and machine-readable access policy were not verified.
provenance: Official domain candidate list; no legislation payload accessed.
known_quality_issues: Home-page authority is not licence or automated-access evidence; exact legislation and copyright pages remain to be located.
required_rights: Locate exact legislation portal, copyright, terms, access, and privacy pages for each selected source.
manual_action: Do not acquire or quote until source-specific terms are recorded.

description: Derived Arabic article-level dataset representing 71 Saudi laws and regulations.
task: statutory article classification; legal text quality inspection
evidence_summary: The dataset card declares 3,185 Arabic article records from 71 Saudi laws and regulations, Parquet format, and CC BY 4.0.
provenance: Uploader states the source is the Saudi Ministry of Justice; this is a derived dataset and not an official MOJ export.
known_quality_issues: Original MOJ text rights, public display, and model training permissions are unresolved; uploader licence is not a blanket MOJ-source licence.
required_rights: Original MOJ source rights; public display; training; official reconciliation; quality inspection.
manual_action: Use only for private local research and controlled parsing after quality audit; obtain an official article-level export and written use clarification before evaluation, training, quotation, or display.
notes: Uploader CC BY 4.0 is recorded separately from rights in Saudi Ministry of Justice source text.
split_info: Dataset card reports 3185 articles and 71 laws; exact revision is pinned in the acquisition specification.
